responsibility: This file implements simple filename construction and splitting helpers for the mc front end. It computes module-based filenames with appended extensions, derives compiler-specific stem names, strips a requested extension when present, and extracts the final path component after the directory separator, making it the small pathname utility layer used by search and source-file handling code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the filename helpers declared in GmcFileName.h, including string construction for module-plus-extension names, stem extraction, extension stripping, and final path-component extraction. Unlike the header, it contains the actual pathname-manipulation logic and directory separator handling.
